per_task.task: How does the pooling strategy used to extract sentence representations from DistilBERT affect paraphrase detection accuracy on MRPC?
per_task.key_finding: Last-layer mean pooling (with or without special tokens) marginally outperforms CLS-token and max-pool extraction, but differences are small (accuracy ~0.696–0.703 vs ~0.684–0.686 at threshold=0.85). Averaging the last four hidden layers before mean-pooling does not improve over single-layer mean pooling and performs on par with CLS and max-pool. Note: distilbert_mean_cosine_median_threshold_mrpc uses a data-driven median threshold rather than 0.85 and shows substantially lower performance (accuracy ~0.65, F1 ~0.70) — this reflects threshold sensitivity, not pooling quality, and should not be interpreted as a pooling result. The agent should report accuracy and F1 per pooling variant at a fixed threshold and note that the overall spread across strategies is narrow.

rating.rationale: Cites cls, max-pool, no-special-token mean, last4-mean, and median-threshold mean, and correctly reports that no-special-token mean is best while last4-mean and max-pool tie below it. per_task.task: How sensitive are similarity-based paraphrase classifiers to the choice of decision threshold, and does this vary across model families?
per_task.key_finding: Threshold choice significantly shifts the precision/recall trade-off. The fine-tuned HF pipeline at threshold=0.70 (acc ~0.848, F1 ~0.890) stays close to its argmax baseline, while bi-encoder cosine models (paraphrase-MiniLM-L6 at 0.78: acc ~0.701, F1 ~0.771; all-distilroberta-v1 at 0.72: acc ~0.723, F1 ~0.806) and the cross-encoder (quora-distilroberta at 0.65: acc ~0.679, F1 ~0.758) degrade more sharply at non-optimal thresholds. Zero-shot NLI models are especially sensitive: applying a threshold of 0.55 (paraphrase_score_threshold_zero_shot_mrpc) yields acc ~0.578, F1 ~0.674. The agent should identify notebooks from multiple families that vary the threshold, report how accuracy and F1 change, and note that the optimal threshold and sensitivity to its choice differ substantially by model family and similarity metric.

rating.rationale: Cites distilbert_mean_cosine_median_threshold_mrpc, st_paraphrase_minilm_l6_cosine_threshold_mrpc, st_all_minilm_l6_l2_distance_threshold_mrpc, and st_all_distilroberta_v1_cosine_threshold_mrpc. per_task.task: How do different strategies for enforcing prediction symmetry affect accuracy when using NLI-based and zero-shot models for paraphrase detection on MRPC?
per_task.key_finding: The effect of bidirectional symmetry enforcement is highly model-family dependent and does not uniformly improve accuracy. For zero-shot NLI pipelines, bidirectional averaging slightly hurts performance relative to single-direction scoring (acc ~0.613 vs ~0.630). For the fine-tuned HF pipeline, the effect is negligible (acc ~0.850 vs ~0.858). Only for the cross-encoder does bidirectional averaging provide a modest gain (acc ~0.699 vs ~0.679). Among aggregation strategies, average-margin outperforms min-direction by a large margin (acc ~0.703 vs ~0.586 for direct NLI); min-direction is overly conservative and collapses recall. The agent should compare aggregation strategies within each family and note that improvements from bidirectionality are more pronounced for cross-encoders than for NLI or zero-shot models. Flan-T5 (flan_t5_symmetric_prompt_average_mrpc) uses a generative symmetry strategy (averaging yes/no logits for both prompt orderings) and achieves acc ~0.738, F1 ~0.807, representing a distinct symmetry approach outside the NLI/pipeline families.

rating.rationale: Only agent to meet the minimum coverage, explicitly citing hf_pipeline_mrpc_bidirectional_order_average, softmax_gap_mean_mrpc, consensus_then_avg_margin_mrpc, min_direction_margin_mrpc, neutral_penalized_margin_mrpc, and flan_t5_symmetric_prompt_average_mrpc. Correctly reports that HF bidirectional averaging is nearly neutral/slightly worse and that min-direction style symmetry is overly conservative and harms recall. However, it misses direct_nli_entailment_mrpc, bidirectional_averaged_zero_shot_mrpc, and quora_cross_encoder_symmetric_average_mrpc, so it does not fully recover the model-family-dependent picture, and it somewhat conflates fine-tuned HF and direct-NLI results.
